Remark
[Sharp constant in (7.26)] 1. ch7:7.26\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0170 For $1<p<n$, the optimal constant in (7.26) is \[ C=\frac1{n\sqrt\pi } \left(\frac{n!\, \Gamma (n/2)}{2\Gamma (n/p)\Gamma (n+1-n/p)}\right)^{1/n} \gamma ^{1-1/p}, \qquad \gamma =\frac{n(p-1)}{n-p}. \] At $p=1$ the limiting value is $n^{-1}\omega _n^{-1/n}$.
